# What the Pages deploy publishes (.github/workflows/pages.yml). Only what is listed here goes on the site:
# everything else in the repo (src/ code, server/, tools/, docs/, notes, design files, models' sources) stays
# off it. A folder brings everything inside it. One path per line, from the repo root; # starts a comment.
#
# Adding a file the live pages load? Add it here too, or it will be missing on the site (the deploy fails
# if a listed path does not exist, so a typo shows up straight away).

index.html
lab.html
lab3d.html
LICENSE

vendor/

img/
models/scenery.bin

src/camera3d.js
src/kaykit3d.js
src/models3d.js
src/scenery3d.js
src/render3d.js

showcase/
